# Platform Foundation Checklist: 001 Platform Foundation

**Purpose**: Reviewer questions about the completeness, clarity, consistency, and verifiability of the foundation requirements—not an implementation test plan.
**Created**: 2026-09-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `/speckit-checklist` from the approved feature scope and requested focus areas.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when a reviewer judges the *written requirements* sufficient.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` does not mean any code was implemented or tested.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the core, platform, business-domain, and shared-boundary responsibilities specified well enough to place new capabilities without ambiguity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the conditions for independently starting, building, and operating the two applications explicitly captured as separate acceptance requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all required configuration categories, safe examples, and startup-failure requirements defined without assuming committed secrets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are database initialization, connectivity, schema-change history, and safe evolution requirements all covered without requiring a speculative entity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are success, validation, expected application, service/network, and unexpected error categories all accounted for across the integration boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the contract source, generated client relationship, development documentation access, and production build artifact each specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the global layout, styling, page structure, loading, empty, error, not-found, and unexpected-failure requirements each represented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Are developer documentation requirements explicit for module placement, local startup, configuration, migrations, API usage, and quality commands? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is the permitted dependency direction and the meaning of reusable versus business-specific code unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the required configuration values and invalid-value failure expectations distinguishable from optional settings without relying on unspecified defaults? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the success/error conventions precise enough to distinguish validation details from safe generic internal failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007–FR-008; Plan §Architecture and Contracts]
- [ ] CHK012 Is request correlation defined clearly enough for absent, malformed, and accepted identifiers, including the response-to-log relationship? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the meaning of “operational status” versus database-dependent readiness clear, including their dependency-failure outcomes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK014 Is “basic responsive behavior” specified with an objective narrow/wide acceptance boundary without over-prescribing a business UI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Are the frontend-backend separation requirement and the single API contract source consistent with the planned shared client package boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-011; Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK016 Are development-only interactive documentation and the production specification artifact requirements consistent across clarification, scenarios, success criteria, and plan? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-011, §SC-003; Plan §Architecture and Contracts]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the no-business-entity scope boundary and database migration/readiness requirements mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006, §Scope Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK018 Are local/workflow state requirements consistent with the ban on duplicating server data in frontend global state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014; Plan §API client and frontend state]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the listed package/dependency directions reconciled with the no-speculative-infrastructure and no-business-feature constraints, including intentionally deferred tools? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §Scope Boundaries; Plan §Constitution Check]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Can each of the brief's 18 acceptance criteria be traced to a written scenario, functional requirement, or measurable outcome without depending only on a planning choice? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Are independent startup, configuration rejection, database readiness failure, and contract availability outcomes objectively assessable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003–SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Are log correlation and absence of sensitive exposure expressed as observable criteria rather than vague “safe logging” language? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the neutral shell and all five shared states identified in a way that makes narrow/wide usability assessable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK024 Are quality gate expectations specific enough to distinguish documented commands from evidence of their actual outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §SC-007]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are the primary fresh-start, platform extension, business-domain placement, API consumption, operations, and frontend-shell journeys all represented by independently understandable scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–6]
- [ ] CHK026 Are missing/invalid configuration and unavailable database scenarios paired with their expected startup or readiness outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §User Stories 1 and 4]
- [ ] CHK027 Are invalid input, service outage, malformed or unreadable responses, and unexpected internal failures differentiated in the requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Are documentation access requirements explicit for both development and production environments, including the absence of an interactive page in production? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK029 Are failed schema changes and recovery/rollback expectations documented at the requirements or plan level, or explicitly identified as deferred until real data exists? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-006; Plan §Risks and Architectural Decisions]
- [ ] CHK030 Are unknown routes and failed frontend rendering addressed separately from ordinary empty and loading states? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements and Security

- [ ] CHK031 Are the secrecy boundaries for source control, public responses, diagnostics, and frontend configuration defined consistently? [Security, Spec §FR-004–FR-005, §FR-008–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the intended public surface and future default-deny rule documented without silently introducing an authentication feature now? [Security, Spec §Scope Boundaries; Plan §Architecture and Contracts]
- [ ] CHK033 Are keyboard access and understandable fallback-state requirements stated sufficiently for the neutral interactive frontend, or explicitly deferred with rationale? [Accessibility, Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK034 Are unavailable performance, scale, and availability targets explicitly distinguished from acceptance requirements, rather than implied by “production-oriented”? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK035 Are structured diagnostic field requirements and sensitive-field exclusions coherent with the correlation and failure-diagnosis goals? [Observability, Spec §FR-009, §SC-005]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Scope Conflicts

- [ ] CHK036 Are local database provisioning and environment-specific settings identified as developer prerequisites rather than hidden product dependencies? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK037 Are contract export, generated types, database availability, and independent frontend startup ordered consistently with their dependencies? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006, §FR-011; Plan §Implementation Phases]
- [ ] CHK038 Are authentication, users, roles, notifications, files, audit, tenancy, business entities, and speculative infrastructure unambiguously excluded from this feature? [Consistency, Spec §Scope Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK039 Are any plan-level choices presented as though they amend product behavior, rather than as reversible technical decisions subordinate to the specification and Constitution? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Risks and Architectural Decisions]

## Notes

- Leave items unchecked until a reviewer evaluates requirement writing; do not mark `[x]` based on implementation or automated test results.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but must not modify these markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` is a separate built-in specification-quality checklist with its own lifecycle.
- Add findings under the relevant item and revise spec/plan before implementation if a material gap is identified.
